title: Sound Stage
author: Seth Morrow
description: Sound made in script and mixed live by the audioxt extension: a beat on the mixer's own clock, a bee that flies round your head in 3D, a synth with fades, a tape mixed in memory and played back, and your microphone. It starts on its own, and the sound with your first click; press Play all or pick a scene. Headphones help in the 3D scene. The gallery gives no stack a microphone, so that scene says so.
